messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "some combination products contain tramadol"
set: ["some combination products contain tramadol", "avoid consuming grapefruit products", "do not take tramadol together with any other medicine that contains tramadol", "different products are not interchangeable", "tell doctor about herbal products", "do not consume grapefruit products", "some brands have different recommendations", "avoid these products to ensure effectiveness", "avoid drinking alcohol or using medicines that contain alcohol", "some brands have different dosage instructions", "some conditions require steroid treatment during pregnancy", "bottle sizes vary between products and pack sizes", "combination provides better pain relief than one medicine by itself", "may be used in combination with non-nsaid with rapid onset", "do not take with any other medicine that contains tramadol", "within 24 hours: some people get complete relief"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
